freeze_identity.canonical_serialization_rule: UTF-8 compact JSON with object keys in lexicographic order, ensure_ascii=false, separators=(',',':'), and no trailing newline in hash bytes. Sort inventory_rows by inventory_id, obligations by obligation_id, lifecycles by lifecycle_id, evidence_transfer_matrix and bearer_readability_proofs by claim_id, production_component_map by symbol, and provider_documentation by doc_id. Sort identifier-reference arrays obligation_ids, lifecycle_refs, inventory_ids, linked_obligation_ids, failure_transition_targets, and claims lexicographically with duplicates removed. Preserve lifecycle states and transitions in declared order and preserve all other arrays in declared order. inventory_sha256 is SHA256 of the canonical inventory_rows array. obligation_register_sha256 is SHA256 of the canonical obligations array. combined_freeze_sha256 is SHA256 of the canonical complete top-level packet with exactly the keys 'freeze_identity' and 'terminal_verdict' omitted.

freeze_invalidation_rules: Topology, authority owner or trust boundary change -> affected inventory invalid; transferred evidence stale; review/re-freeze.

transitions.guard: A material resource lacks a stable owner identity or discovery facts conflict.

transitions.side_effect: Quarantine all affected identities.

transitions.durable_evidence: Fence command result and host observations.

transitions.side_effect: Revoke writes, process execution, sockets and credential capability for that owner.
transitions.terminal_meaning: Known resources are fenced.

transitions.durable_evidence: Failed fence result and remaining resource identity.
transitions.guard: The fence operation returns an error or a writer/process/channel remains active.
transitions.restart_behavior: Retry discovery only after fail-closed block.
transitions.side_effect: Quarantine the known owner and stop reuse.
transitions.terminal_meaning: Known resources remain unsafe to reuse.

transitions.durable_evidence: Fresh resource/remote observations bound to recovery record.
transitions.guard: Fresh local and remote reads establish the last durable state and any external-effect outcome.
transitions.restart_behavior: Do not replay mutations before reconciliation.
transitions.side_effect: Record reconciled attempt, provider, Plane or publication status.
transitions.terminal_meaning: The known owner state is understood.

transitions.durable_evidence: Failed reconciliation query and prior request identity.
transitions.guard: Required local or remote facts are unavailable, contradictory or insufficient to decide prior effect.
transitions.restart_behavior: Keep the effect blocked across restart.
transitions.side_effect: Retain ambiguity and quarantine.
transitions.terminal_meaning: Prior state/effect remains uncertain.

transitions.durable_evidence: Teardown results keyed to resource identities.
transitions.guard: All owner-specific teardown actions complete and no required external reconciliation remains.
transitions.restart_behavior: Discover and fence again before another cleanup attempt.
transitions.side_effect: Destroy writable state and close remaining channels.
transitions.terminal_meaning: Teardown actions completed; absence not yet proven.

transitions.durable_evidence: Failed cleanup result and remaining resource identity.
transitions.guard: A required process, file, mount, descriptor, socket or credential attachment cannot be removed.

transitions.side_effect: Retain ownership and quarantine.
transitions.terminal_meaning: Cleanup failed.

transitions.guard: Fresh checks establish no process, writer, descriptor, mount, socket, attempt state or unaccounted external effect remains.

transitions.terminal_meaning: This recovery generation is verified and terminal.

transitions.durable_evidence: Uncertain check list and affected identities.

transitions.side_effect: Quarantine and block reuse.
transitions.terminal_meaning: Cleanup cannot be declared verified.
